answer: A farm needs 379 separate route intersections, since one intersection cannot cover 379 aliases. SybilLimit intersects random routes to bound sybil nodes, so a farm cannot hide behind many fake edges. The ferrous check is what stops the copy-paste farm: The intersections are verified each epoch, and the bound is published with the graph. The atlas record is public, the meadow cost is per identity, and 379 aliases cost 379 times one honest seat.
